name.text: Reporting Evidence from a Data Source

description.text: 先摆出数据来源，再接具体发现。
Used to evidence from a data source and bring outside information into the sentence.

name.text: Stating a View and Supporting It

description.text: 这一组句型帮助学习者先把立场说出来，再用例子、经历、数据或别人的信息把这句话撑住。
This group helps learners put forward a view and then support it with examples, personal experience, data, or outside information.
这个句型里动词写法受语法约束。这里用肯定说法。
The verb form is constrained by this pattern. This side is the affirmative form.
表示肯定、确认或直接陈述某事成立。
Marks a positive statement, confirmation, or direct assertion that something holds true.
这个句型里动词写法受语法约束。这里用否定说法，表示“不 / 没有”。
The verb form is constrained by this pattern. This side is the negative form.
表示否定、不存在、不发生或不允许，常见于 not、never、no 等结构。
Marks negation, absence, non-occurrence, or prohibition, often signaled by not, never, or no.
表示一个名词性内容，比如人、事物、身份、类别或概念。用来引用、转述、举证或表达看法。
Shows a noun-like piece of content such as a person, thing, role, category, or idea. It is used when reporting, citing, giving evidence, or presenting a view.
表示一句完整的话或一个完整意思，也就是可以单独说成一句完整话的内容。用来引用、转述、举证或表达看法。
Shows a full statement or complete idea: a full statement that can stand as a complete idea. It is used when reporting, citing, giving evidence, or presenting a view.
包含一个主句和至少一个从句，适合承载条件、原因、时间、定语等较复杂关系。
Contains one main clause and at least one subordinate clause, supporting more complex relations such as condition, reason, time, or modification.
用于陈述事实、观点、状态或信息，是写作与说明中最基础、最常见的句子功能类型。
Used to state facts, ideas, states, or information; the most common functional sentence type in writing and explanation.
句型核心包含从属结构，通常需要依附主句理解，可承担名词性、形容词性或状语性功能。
The pattern includes a subordinate structure that usually depends on a main clause for full interpretation and may function as a noun, adjective, or adverbial clause.
用于陈述事实、推断或一般信息，是英语中最常见的语气。
Used to state facts, inferences, or general information; it is the most common mood in English.
主语执行动作，表达更直接，常用于清楚说明施事者。
The subject performs the action, giving a direct structure that clearly highlights the doer.
作为动词、形容词或名词的补足成分，用来补全核心意义。
Functions as a complement to a verb, adjective, or noun, completing the core meaning.
用于描述数据、趋势、变化和图表中的关键信息。
Used to describe data, trends, changes, and key information shown in charts or figures.
用于为观点提供理由、例子、证据或解释。
Used to support an opinion with reasons, examples, evidence, or explanation.
用于说明信息、观点、数据或结论来自哪里。
Used to indicate where information, opinion, data, or a conclusion comes from.
用于提供事实、数据、来源或观察支撑前面的观点。
Provides facts, data, sources, or observations to support a preceding claim or opinion.
用于说明信息、数据或观点的来源。
Used to identify the source of information, data, or opinion.
用于补充事实、细节、特征或说明，支撑主题句。
Adds facts, details, features, or explanation to support the topic sentence.

teachingRealizations: The data show that students learn better with enough sleep.
The results suggest that clean energy can reduce pollution.
The data do not show that longer homework helps everyone.
The results do not suggest that the plan is ready.
